full_judgment: 3. The facts relevant for disposal of this Rule are that, the opposite party No.1, Md Ayub Ali Chowdhury, had instituted a Title Suit No. 266 of 2006, against the Deputy Commissioner, Narayangonj, and others being defendants, before the Court of Assistant Judge, Narayangonj, seeking declaration of title in respect of 25 decimals of land, alleging that, the plaintiff owns the entire 50 decimals of land lying in CS/SA plot No.192, under Mouja-Oirab, Police Station-Rupgonj, District-Narayangonj; that, during the RS survey operation, said SA Plot No.192 has been converted to RS Plot No.249, but, mistakenly, instead of recording the entire 50 decimals of land of RS plot No.249, in the name of the plaintiff, 25 decimals of land has been wrongly recorded in khas khatian and that this act of recording of 25 decimals of land in Khas Khatian, i.e. in SA khatian No.1 of the aforesaid mouja, was unlawful and that there was no basis, nor the government had any right or title for recording the suit property in the disputed Khas Khatian. The defendants had contested in the suit by filing written statement, in which they denied the case of the defendants and had also stated their own case, asserting their title in the suit property.
